0022600158.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-2, 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, 5th in the West) are on the road against the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-2, 2nd in the Central, 1 game back, 4th in the East), with the Thunder having lost their last two games and the Cavaliers having won their most recent one. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Cleveland's Jaylon Tyson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026.
